faq: What topics make a good lead magnet?
Ones that solve a small, real problem your buyer has right now: a buying checklist, a planning template, a short how-to. We suggest three ideas from your customers' questions and you choose.
We write it from your answers to a short questionnaire and your website. You review it for accuracy within your revisions, because you know your field best.
Can the lead magnet be a video or a discount instead?
Yes. We can plan a short video lesson or a first-order offer as the gift. The price covers the written or designed version, and video production is quoted separately.
Is it ok to email people who download it?
Only if the form tells them clearly that they will receive emails and they agree. We add the consent wording, and an unsubscribe link in every message.

desc:
Lead magnet creation turns a useful guide, checklist or template into a reason for a stranger to share an email address. Ecom Swift LLC chooses the idea, writes and designs the file, and sets up the sign-up form and automatic delivery email in your own tool.

## What is a lead magnet?

A lead magnet is a small, genuinely useful item that you give away in exchange for contact details. Common forms are a short guide, a checklist, a buying guide, a template or a planner. The visitor fills in a form, receives the file by email and joins your list.

The best ones solve one narrow problem quickly. A reader should finish it in minutes and think, "These people know what they are doing."

## Why most lead magnets fail

Many free downloads attract the wrong audience. A generic "ultimate guide" draws people who like free things, not people who need your service. Others are long, vague or badly designed, so they are never opened. And some are delivered late, or land in a spam folder, which breaks the promise made on the form.

A good lead magnet starts from a real question your buyers ask before they hire or buy. When the topic is closely tied to your service, the people who sign up are already thinking about the problem you solve.

## How a lead magnet improves your lead flow

A lead magnet gives visitors a smaller first step than "contact us." Not everyone is ready to talk to a business on their first visit, but many will take a helpful checklist. Once they have it, you have permission to send useful follow-up emails and to stay in view while they decide.

It also shows your knowledge in practice. A clear guide proves that you understand the buyer's situation better than a paragraph of claims on a web page. How many sign-ups you get depends on your traffic and offer, but a strong magnet gives each visitor a reason to leave their details.

## What a great lead magnet includes

- A topic drawn from the real questions customers ask you.
- A specific promise in the title, such as what the reader will be able to do.
- Short, scannable pages with plain language and examples.
- Your logo, colors and fonts, applied cleanly.
- An actionable step on every page, not only background reading.
- A final page that explains how you can help and how to reach you.
- A download that opens easily on a phone.
- A sign-up form that asks only for what you need.
- An automatic delivery email that arrives within moments.
- A thank-you page or message that tells people what to expect next.

## What we do

We begin by reviewing your service and the questions that come up before people buy. From those, we propose the lead magnet idea and agree on format and length. We then write the content in plain English, design it as a PDF with your brand and prepare a cover image.

Next we build the sign-up form in your own email tool or website builder and write the delivery email. The mid-level package includes the form, the delivery automation and thank-you text. The largest package adds a longer guide, three follow-up emails, setup of the automation and three social posts to promote it. We test the sign-up from start to finish, including how the email and file look on a phone.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Solve one specific problem for one specific reader.
- Keep it short enough to finish in one sitting.
- Say clearly what the reader will get before they sign up.
- Follow the download with a helpful email.
- Share the guide on your site, social profiles and email footer.

**Avoid:**
- Choosing a topic only because it sounds popular.
- Hiding your service so completely that the reader never learns who wrote it.
- Asking for a long list of personal details.
- Sending sales messages with no value after the download.
- Adding people to a list without clear permission.

## Who this service is for

This service suits service businesses that want to start a mailing list from visitors who are not ready to book. It also fits a store or brand that wants a buying guide or sizing checklist. Consultants and coaches who want a simple first offer for new contacts are another good match.

## What we need from you

Share a few of the questions customers ask most, a short description of your service and any material you already have, such as notes or past emails. Send your logo and brand colors. We do not need passwords. Access is given to us as a collaborator, staff or team user in your email or website tool, and everything stays in your own account.
